title: Campus Wi-Fi (GNU-WLAN) Service Guide
body:
Notice: Campus Wi-Fi (GNU-WLAN) Service Guide

Our university provides a campus wireless network service (GNU-WLAN). Please refer to the information below and feel free to use the Wi-Fi service on campus. We encourage all students, staff, and visitors to actively use the wireless network.

1. Service Area

All university campuses: Gajwa, Chilam, Tongyeong, Naedong, and Changwon Industry-Academia Campus

2. Service Locations

Indoor: Classrooms, reading rooms, study rooms, libraries, auditoriums, lobbies, etc.

Outdoor: Areas where many people gather and can access wireless internet.

3. Wi-Fi Access Point (AP) Locations

You can check the Wi-Fi AP locations on the university website:

University Website → Campus Life / Career → IT & Facility Support → Internet / Wi-Fi → Campus Wi-Fi Location Guide

4. Types of Wi-Fi Services

① GNU-WLAN (Authentication required)

② GNU-FREE (No authentication required)

③ EDUROAM (Global Wi-Fi service)

④ GNU-FREE (K-ON) (No authentication required)

※ Any Wi-Fi networks other than the ones listed above are not provided by the university.

Attachment: Campus Wireless Network (Wi-Fi) Installation Status and User Guide (1 file)
